part_a.sentence: 健康的生活对每个人都非常重要。
我认为我们应该每天锻炼。
有些人喜欢在公园里跑步，有些人喜欢在泳池里游泳。
睡眠有助于我们的身体休息和健康成长。
我相信健康的习惯是我们每天能给自己最好的礼物。

part_b.sentence: Healthy living is very important for everyone.
I think we should exercise every single day.
When we exercise, our body becomes strong and our minds feel beautiful inside.
Sleep helps our body rest and grow well.
These two important things make us strong and happy.
